copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 Teams 适配器复制进项目、注册、安装固定版本依赖并跑构建和测试;随后引导完成 Microsoft 365 登录、创建机器人、把凭据写入 .env,最后把机器人安装到 Teams 并链到指定用户,让助手能主动发消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求为当前项目接入 Microsoft Teams 通道,或想让助手能在 Teams 里收发消息时触发。

say.text: 给这个项目接入 Teams 通道
say.note: 开始复制适配器并执行配置流程

say.text: 帮我配置一个 Microsoft Teams 机器人
say.note: 引导登录、创建并安装机器人

say.text: 把 Teams 机器人绑定到我的账号
say.note: 完成安装并让助手主动发消息

howto.what_en: Copies the Teams adapter into the project, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, and runs build/tests. Then guides Microsoft 365 login, bot creation, writes credentials to .env, installs the bot into Teams, and wires it to a user so the assistant can message them first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Microsoft Teams channel integration to the current project or to let the assistant send/receive messages in Teams.

say_en.text: Add Teams channel integration to this project
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and running setup

say_en.text: Set up a Microsoft Teams bot for me
Wire the Teams bot to my account
say_en.note: Installs and makes the assistant message you
